purpose: Handoff package for Claude Code to build the Architect Lab learning portal

files.VALIDATION_MATRIX.md: Requirement-by-requirement check of this package with honest gaps
files.project_spec.json: Machine-readable specification: functional (20 features, 62 acceptance criteria), non-functional, stack, repo structure, deployment, tests, docs, out of scope, assumptions
files.config/engine.json: Tunable mastery, recommender, assessment and spaced-review parameters
files.schemas/: JSON Schemas: topic, case, source, question, resource, card, lesson_frontmatter, progress_export (+ example)
files.content/curriculum_blueprint.json: Pillars, modules, topics, competencies, patterns, levels, depth model; topics link to verified cases
files.content/case_catalog_batch1.json: 14 cases with tiers, tagged facts, decisions, backlog, coverage gaps
files.content/source_register.json: 30 sources with grades and check dates
files.docs/: Human-readable research report, curriculum, catalog and functional spec

relationships.case.facts[1] -> case.sources: fact source must be listed in the case
